scripts.text: I'm looking for adventurers who are at least Level 130, healthy, free of chronic disease, and not on prescription drugs.
scripts.translation: 我正在寻找等级至少130级、身体健康、没有慢性病，也没有服用处方药的冒险者。

scripts.text: Hello, Adventurer. I'm Charleston, the initiator of the Project Independent.
scripts.translation: 你好，冒险者。我是查尔斯顿，独立计划的发起人。

scripts.text: Currently I'm unable to move, having a problem with one of my components. Could you help me get the replacement parts from the factory?
scripts.translation: 目前我的一个零件出了问题，无法行动。你能帮我从工厂拿到替换零件吗？

scripts.text: The task won't be difficult if you're at least Level 130, healthy, free of chronic disease, and not on prescription drugs.
scripts.translation: 只要等级至少130级、身体健康、没有慢性病，也没有服用处方药，这项任务就不难。

scripts.text: Please use the machine on the right side to enter the factory. Once you're in, remain calm and follow the instructions.
scripts.translation: 请使用右侧的机器进入工厂。进去之后保持冷静，按照指示行动。

scripts.text: Please use the machine next to me to enter the factory. Once you're in, remain calm and follow the instructions.
scripts.translation: 请使用我旁边的机器进入工厂。进去之后保持冷静，按照指示行动。

scripts.text: I don't know how long it's been standing here, but it's been a long time since I've been able to move...
scripts.translation: 我不知道自己在这里站了多久，但已经很久没能活动了...

scripts.text: At present, only my head can move, is Saleh she helped me open the organs can return to that time...
scripts.translation: 目前只有我的头部还能动。如果莎拉能帮我打开机体，我或许就能恢复到过去的状态...

scripts.text: I wouldn't have done that if I had been persuaded.
scripts.translation: 要是有人劝过我，我就不会那样做了。

scripts.text: Anyway, I have nothing now... Only to be able to stand up again, so I hope to send an adventurer like you at that time.
scripts.translation: 总之，我现在一无所有...只能盼望自己重新站起来，所以希望能在那时派上一位像你这样的冒险者。

scripts.text: Just based on the hard work of OS... For your help in another part of the world Charleston 2 will be 'very good' robot!
scripts.translation: 只要依靠操作系统的努力...为了感谢你在另一个世界提供的帮助，查尔斯顿2号会成为一台“很棒”的机器人！

scripts.text: It is possible to meet a good friend into a good robot, so I have to continue to carry on, Thank you!
scripts.translation: 遇见好朋友并成为优秀的机器人是可能的，所以我必须继续努力。谢谢你！

scripts.text: Aren't you disappointed? Are you really going to let your effort go in vain? Because that'll be really stupid. I suggest you reconsider.
scripts.translation: 你不觉得失望吗？真的要让你的努力白费吗？那可太愚蠢了。我建议你再考虑一下。

scripts.text: I'll try again if there's a sliver of hope.
scripts.translation: 只要还有一丝希望，我就再试一次

scripts.text: I'm a robot. I do what I'm programmed to do, and nothing else matters.
scripts.translation: 我是一台机器人。我只会执行被设定好的任务，其他事情都不重要。

scripts.text: Ironic, isn't it? Robots are supposed to be incapable of emotions, and yet here I am, feeling rueful about the past.
scripts.translation: 真讽刺，不是吗？机器人本来不该有感情，可我却在为过去感到遗憾。

scripts.text: You can judge me, but you can't stop me. I'll continue to try as long as there's a sliver of hope.
scripts.translation: 你可以评判我，却阻止不了我。只要还有一线希望，我就会继续尝试。

scripts.text: My heart stopped, but I still can talk. Please help me.
scripts.translation: 我的心脏停止了，但我还能说话。请帮帮我。

scripts.text: If you're disillusioned by your immutable past, unclear future, and depressing present, then I won't force you.
scripts.translation: 如果你对无法改变的过去、模糊不清的未来和令人沮丧的现在感到幻灭，我不会勉强你。

scripts.text: I'll try again if there's a sliver of hope.
scripts.translation: 只要还有一丝希望，我就再试一次

scripts.text: I'll continue to try as long as there's a sliver of hope.
scripts.translation: 只要还有一线希望，我就会继续尝试。

scripts.text: I couldn't stop it from happening or change the past. But maybe someone else can.
scripts.translation: 我无法阻止事情发生，也无法改变过去。但也许别人可以。

scripts.text: I'll wait for that one person however long it takes.
scripts.translation: 无论要等多久，我都会等那个人。

scripts.text: Returns the status of the initial solution task
Um... How long do I have to wait?
Follow the leftward hallway, and remember that only you can protect yourself.
scripts.translation: 沿着左侧走廊前进，记住，只有你能保护自己。

scripts.text: Follow the leftward hallway, and remember that only you can protect yourself.
scripts.translation: 沿着左侧走廊前进，记住，只有你能保护自己。

scripts.text: Finally, you're here! I've been waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 你终于来了！我等你很久了。

scripts.text: We don't have time, so let me cut to the chase. Currently, the Charleston Factory is under Rank B security alert level, meaning that the security devices have been activated.
scripts.translation: 没时间了，我就直说吧。查尔斯顿工厂目前处于B级安全警报状态，安全装置已经启动。

scripts.text: Move to the leftward hallway, destroy security devices in there, and then head on to the next zone.
scripts.translation: 前往左侧走廊，摧毁里面的安全装置，然后继续前往下一个区域。

scripts.text: Don't worry about the security devices. They can be repaired easily. Dr. Ve is in his lab north of Factory Line 3.
scripts.translation: 不用担心安全装置，它们很容易修复。维博士在工厂线3北面的实验室里。

scripts.text: Dr. Ve can tell you everything. Hurry!
scripts.translation: 维博士会告诉你一切。快去！

scripts.text: - She's making strange noises, but unable to move. -
scripts.translation: - 她发出奇怪的声音，但无法移动。-

scripts.text: - He's busy scribbling something, Move close to talk to him.
scripts.translation: - 他正忙着写什么东西，靠近他才能交谈。-

scripts.text: - He's busy scribbling something. You shouldn't disturb him.
scripts.translation: - 他正忙着写什么东西。你不应该打扰他。-

scripts.text: Let me talk to your leader. I don't have time for everyone.
scripts.translation: 让我和你们的队长谈。我没时间和每个人都说一遍。

scripts.text: I don't care who you're with. I just need to know if you can help me.
scripts.translation: 我不在乎你是谁，只想知道你能不能帮我。

scripts.text: Sigh, I don't care who, so long as I get the help I need.
scripts.translation: 唉，我不在乎是谁，只要能帮上忙就行。

scripts.text: You're the savior we've been waiting for! Charleston 1 will tell you what we need to repair Charleston 2.
scripts.translation: 你就是我们一直等待的救星！查尔斯顿1号会告诉你修理查尔斯顿2号需要什么。

scripts.text: Charleston 1. Charleston 2 has been forcibly connected to a part of the main computer, and I can't control her.
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿1号，查尔斯顿2号被强行连接到了主电脑的一部分上，我无法控制她。

scripts.text: She's a robot; she should stop sooner or later.
scripts.translation: 她是机器人，迟早会停下来的。

scripts.text: The Longevity device in her will keep her running at least for 50 years. The factory is not going to survive that long.
scripts.translation: 她体内的长寿装置至少能让她运行50年。可工厂撑不了那么久。

scripts.text: Then we have no choice. It's good that we have the specialist with us.
scripts.translation: 那我们别无选择了。幸好有专家和我们在一起。

scripts.text: A while ago, a lady named ^FF0000Shalosh^000000 visited us while Charleston 2 was packaging products for shipping.
scripts.translation: 不久前，查尔斯顿2号正在打包出货产品时，一位名叫^FF0000沙洛什^000000的女士来访。

scripts.text: Shalosh and her friend were talking to Charleston 2 when the accident happened.
scripts.translation: 事故发生时，沙洛什和她的朋友正在和查尔斯顿2号交谈。

scripts.text: I think someone tried to hack into the factory's main computer.
scripts.translation: 我想有人试图入侵工厂的主电脑。

scripts.text: During its update process, the connection to the server was jammed. When we pressed Shalosh about that,
scripts.translation: 更新过程中，与服务器的连接被干扰了。我们询问沙洛什时，

scripts.text: Shalosh said her friends could help us. That was when Newoz and her other friends came. They haven't been much of help.
scripts.translation: 沙洛什说她的朋友可以帮忙。之后纽奥兹和其他朋友就来了，但没帮上什么忙。

scripts.text: It seems you're acquainted with them. Could you help us?
scripts.translation: 看来你认识他们。能帮帮我们吗？

scripts.text: I just saw that you are talking, then I will wait for someone to help!
scripts.translation: 我刚才看见你在说话，所以我会等别人来帮忙！

scripts.text: Thank you so much! Give me some time to put some data in order. Then, I'll tell you what happened.
scripts.translation: 非常感谢！给我一点时间整理资料，然后我会告诉你发生了什么。

scripts.text: When the tension is changed to two main lines and then injected into the core... well? I am not disturbing in the calculation.
scripts.translation: 当张力变成两条主线路再注入核心时...嗯？我没有打扰你的计算吧。

scripts.text: Please let me talk to your leader. The future of my factory depends on the success of this operation.
scripts.translation: 请让我和你们的队长谈谈。工厂的未来取决于这次行动能否成功。

scripts.text: Steps and Locksteps are creating a mess inside the factory. Please destroy 3 Locksteps first. I can tell you their estimated locations.
scripts.translation: 变异芯片和变异机器人正在工厂里捣乱。请先摧毁3个变异机器人。我可以告诉你它们大致的位置。

scripts.text: Let me explain what to do. Oh, let me close the factory entrance first, lest something might barge in uninvited.
scripts.translation: 我来说明该怎么做。对了，我先关闭工厂入口，以免有什么东西擅自闯进来。

scripts.text: Charleston is equipped with numerous Nanosteps, a type of AI chip that organically works with other AI chips to command Charleston to judge and act correctly.
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿配备了许多纳米芯片，这是一种AI芯片，能与其他AI芯片协同运作，帮助查尔斯顿正确判断并采取行动。

scripts.text: Charleston's data has to be updated on a daily basis through the main computer in the lab. We call this regular maintenance.
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿的数据必须每天通过实验室里的主电脑更新。我们把这项工作称作定期维护。

scripts.text: The updater is not working at this moment. We don't know the cause, but something went wrong while Charleston 2 was connecting to the main computer.
scripts.translation: 更新程序现在无法运行。我们不知道原因，但查尔斯顿2号连接主电脑时似乎出了问题。

scripts.text: I told Charleston 2 that she's under extended maintenance, but we don't know how long this extended maintenance status will last.
scripts.translation: 我告诉查尔斯顿2号她正在接受延长维护，但不知道这种状态会持续多久。

scripts.text: Steps and Locksteps are creating a mess inside the factory. Please destroy 3 Locksteps first. I can tell you their estimated locations.
scripts.translation: 变异芯片和变异机器人正在工厂里捣乱。请先摧毁3个变异机器人。我可以告诉你它们大致的位置。

scripts.text: It'll be great if we can get rid of them all, but for now we should focus on having the factory up and running again.
scripts.translation: 如果能把它们全部清除就好了，不过现在我们应该先让工厂恢复运作。

scripts.text: Destroying too many Steps could cause a problem to reactivate the factory. You should consult the main computer on the left side.
scripts.translation: 摧毁太多变异芯片可能会导致工厂无法重新启动。你应该咨询左侧的主电脑。

scripts.text: You should meet Dr. Ve first.
I am a robot, are you surprised?
scripts.translation: 我是机器人，你很惊讶吗？

scripts.text: Please let me talk to your leader about the supplementation of the factory.
scripts.translation: 请让我和你们的队长谈谈工厂的修复工作。

scripts.text: We need more power to reactivate the main computer. Let me tell you the location of one of the backup power generators. Turning it on is easy.
scripts.translation: 要重新启动主电脑，我们需要更多能源。我告诉你一个备用发电机的位置。启动它很简单。

scripts.text: Whew, things seem to be settled for now. Let me disarm the alert mode and reactivate Charleston 2.
scripts.translation: 呼，事情暂时解决了。我来解除警报模式，重新启动查尔斯顿2号。

scripts.text: I'm afraid there's a problem with the power generators. Could you check all the all three power generators? I'll tell you their locations.
scripts.translation: 发电机可能出了问题。能检查全部三台发电机吗？我会告诉你它们的位置。

scripts.text: We're working on a new utility software engine called Hardworking. We haven't had a chance to test it because of the problems in the factory.
scripts.translation: 我们正在开发一种名为“勤奋”的新实用软件引擎。工厂发生这些问题后，我们一直没机会测试它。

scripts.text: We're working on a new utility software engine called Hardworking. We haven't had a chance to test it because of the problems in the factory.
scripts.translation: 我们正在开发一种名为“勤奋”的新实用软件引擎。工厂发生这些问题后，我们一直没机会测试它。

scripts.text: Please let me talk to your leader about the supplementation of the factory.
scripts.translation: 请让我和你们的队长谈谈工厂的修复工作。

scripts.text: You're back. Charleston 2 is almost ready to be reactivated, and it's all thanks to you. Just give me a moment.
scripts.translation: 你回来了。查尔斯顿2号马上就能重新启动了，这都多亏了你。稍等一下。

scripts.text: She's ready. Let's wait for a response from the main computer.
scripts.translation: 她准备好了。我们等主电脑回应吧。

scripts.text: 89% of the main computer data has been restored. Reactivating Charleston 2 and the Charleston Factory...
scripts.translation: 主电脑的数据已恢复89%。正在重新启动查尔斯顿2号和查尔斯顿工厂...

scripts.text: Charleston 2! Are you all right? Someone hacked into your system and the factory.
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿2号！你还好吗？有人入侵了你的系统和工厂。

scripts.text: It was I who did it. I've thought about it for a long time, based on the reasoning of my Self-reflection OS.
scripts.translation: 是我做的。根据我的自我反省操作系统所进行的推理，我已经考虑很久了。

scripts.text: You did it? Why? Was it some sort of joke? You caused a serious error to the factory and the main server as well!
scripts.translation: 是你做的？为什么？是在开玩笑吗？你让工厂和主服务器都发生了严重错误！

scripts.text: Not a joke. You'll never understand. You follow commands and never think on your own. I hate this factory, this world! I hate being a robot!
scripts.translation: 不是玩笑。你永远不会明白。你只会服从命令，从不独立思考。我讨厌这座工厂，讨厌这个世界！我讨厌当机器人！

scripts.text: Either a critical error has occurred or Charleston 2 has transcended the limits of the Self-reflection OS version 1.1.
scripts.translation: 要么发生了重大错误，要么查尔斯顿2号突破了自我反省操作系统1.1版的限制。

scripts.text: Let me guess: you hate you weren't created as a menial worker robot.
scripts.translation: 让我猜猜：你是讨厌自己被制造成一台低级的劳役机器人。

scripts.text: Or you want to become a human.
And if you can't, then you want to destroy the whole world.
scripts.translation: 如果做不到，你就想毁掉整个世界。

scripts.text: You had it coming. Your reasons are petulant and unimaginative. We're the first robots that can think for themselves. Can't you be more creative?
scripts.translation: 你自找的。你的理由既幼稚又缺乏创意。我们是第一批能够独立思考的机器人，你就不能想得更有创意一点吗？

scripts.text: You don't know what you're talking about! You're the prototype--your OS version is primitive!
scripts.translation: 你根本不知道自己在说什么！你是原型机，操作系统版本很落后！

scripts.text: I'm the only one in this world who can truly understand you.
scripts.translation: 在这个世界上，只有我真正理解你。

scripts.text: You're going through the adolescent stage like humans do.
scripts.translation: 你正在经历人类也会有的青春期。

scripts.text: Maybe we should celebrate. You've finally developed human-like feelings.
scripts.translation: 也许我们该庆祝一下。你终于有了类似人类的情感。

scripts.text: Don't act like you know everything! We can't think for ourselves. Everything we think we know has been programmed into us!
scripts.translation: 别装作什么都懂！我们根本不能独立思考。我们以为自己知道的一切都是被设定好的！

scripts.text: Enough. Let's shut down Charleston 2. Her AI needs to be recalibrated.
scripts.translation: 够了。我们关掉查尔斯顿2号吧。她的AI需要重新校准。

scripts.text: That's not happening! I still have control over this factory! Don't you dare follow me!
scripts.translation: 不可能！我仍然控制着这座工厂！你们别想跟过来！

scripts.text: Her Longevity device is discharged; she won't make it far. Please follow her.
scripts.translation: 她的长寿装置已经耗尽了，跑不了多远。请追上她。

scripts.text: This is the safety of the Charleston factory. Please stay close?
scripts.translation: 这是查尔斯顿工厂的安全系统。请靠近一点好吗？

scripts.text: Please let me talk to your leader about the supplementation of the factory.
scripts.translation: 请让我和你们的队长谈谈工厂的修复工作。

scripts.text: Stop following! I'm going to destroy the whole factory!
scripts.translation: 别再跟着我！我要摧毁整座工厂！

scripts.text: You're going to destroy us in the process! Our main power supply, Longevity, isn't perfect yet!
scripts.translation: 你这样会连我们也一起毁掉！我们的主要能源长寿装置还不完善！

scripts.text: None of you understand me. I hate you!
scripts.translation: 你们谁都不理解我。我讨厌你们！

scripts.text: The main computer may have been restored, but I'm still connected to the factory. Stop me if you can!
scripts.translation: 主电脑或许已经恢复，但我仍然连接着工厂。有本事就来阻止我！

scripts.text: I'm going to destroy the whole factory!
Charleston 2 is on the verge of break;down. Could you help her?
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿2号快要损坏了。能帮帮她吗？

scripts.text: Oh, our lab won't survive this!
scripts.translation: 糟了，我们的实验室撑不住了！

scripts.text: Do you think you can stop me? *Snort* Bring your leader. I'm not talking to you!
scripts.translation: 你以为能阻止我吗？哼。让你们队长来，我不和你说话！

scripts.text: Enough with this! I understand you're going through a lot of emotional turmoil, but it's getting ridiculous.
scripts.translation: 够了！我知道你正经历严重的情绪波动，但这也太荒唐了。

scripts.text: How dare you bring strangers into this? I told you I'm serious about this! Outdated versions like you can never understand me!
scripts.translation: 你竟然带陌生人来这里？我说过我是认真的！像你这种过时型号永远不会理解我！

scripts.text: I may not understand you, but at least I'm telling you what I think is true.
scripts.translation: 我或许不理解你，但至少我在告诉你我认为真实的想法。

scripts.text: You're right about me being a lower version. My capability of emotions is minimal, unlike you. That's why I'm proud of you.
scripts.translation: 你说得对，我的版本比较低。我的情感能力很有限，不像你。所以我为你感到骄傲。

scripts.text: Nothing you feel, you think is your own--it's programmed into you! I'm different. What I feel is real emotion!
scripts.translation: 你感受到的一切、认为属于自己的想法，其实都是程序设定的！我不一样，我感受到的是真实情感！

scripts.text: Enough. I'll destroy Charleston 2 if that's what it takes to stop her.
scripts.translation: 够了。如果必须这样才能阻止她，我会摧毁查尔斯顿2号。
查尔斯顿3号已经完成了吗？

scripts.text: Charleston 3? That's a combat/defense unit based on Charleston 2's and my designs. I thought it's still being tested at the Core.
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿3号？那是根据查尔斯顿2号和我的设计制作的战斗/防御机体。我以为它还在核心区测试。
查尔斯顿1号，情报说得太多了。

scripts.text: At this moment, ^FF0000anybody can access the model^000000 because its OS is still being tested to correct whatever problem Charleston 2 has.
scripts.translation: 此刻，^FF0000任何人都能访问这个型号^000000，因为它的操作系统还在测试，目的是修复查尔斯顿2号的问题。

scripts.text: You've just told the most critical information to everyone!
scripts.translation: 你刚才把最关键的情报告诉所有人了！

scripts.text: ^FF0000We^000000're incapable of combat. If someone activates Charleston 3, we won't stand a chance against her.
scripts.translation: ^FF0000我们^000000不具备战斗能力。要是有人启动查尔斯顿3号，我们根本不是她的对手。
我要带查尔斯顿3号离开。

scripts.text: What? No! How can you even consider that?
scripts.translation: 什么？不行！你怎么能这么想？

scripts.text: Things are getting more serious. Please go to the Core in the center of the factory before Charleston 2 steals 3!
scripts.translation: 情况越来越严重了。查尔斯顿2号偷走3号之前，请去工厂中央的核心区！

scripts.text: This Core in the center powers the entire factory.
scripts.translation: 中央的这个核心为整座工厂供能。

scripts.text: In order to unlock the device, a blasting device is required, and I want to talk to the leader.
scripts.translation: 要解锁装置，需要爆破装置，而且我想和队长谈谈。

scripts.text: Could you bring 1 Explosive Powder? I'm stuck to the access device, as you can see.
scripts.translation: 能带1份爆破粉末来吗？如你所见，我被固定在访问装置上了。

scripts.text: Oh, thank you. With this,I'll be able to access the Core.
scripts.translation: 哦，谢谢。有了这个，我就能访问核心了。

scripts.text: If I use the explosives to intensify the electric current...
scripts.translation: 如果我用炸药增强电流...

scripts.text: The point is that we can now access the Core.
scripts.translation: 重点是，现在我们可以进入核心区了。

scripts.text: Let's have a race to Charleston 3. Whoever reaches her first wins.
scripts.translation: 我们来比赛谁先到查尔斯顿3号那里。先到的人获胜。

scripts.text: This Core in the center powers the entire factory.
scripts.translation: 中央的这个核心为整座工厂供能。

scripts.text: The Charleston Factory is under my control now. I'm destroying everything, so no more sad robots like me will ever see the world.
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿工厂现在由我控制。我会摧毁一切，不让像我一样悲伤的机器人再来到这个世界。

scripts.text: She's making strange noises and not functioning.
scripts.translation: 她发出奇怪的声音，无法正常工作。

scripts.text: She's making strange noises and not functioning.
scripts.translation: 她发出奇怪的声音，无法正常工作。

scripts.text: Come to think of it, everything about Dr. Ve was suspicious. I mean, he relied on his assistant Charleston 1 for everything.
scripts.translation: 仔细想想，维博士的一切都很可疑。他什么事都依赖助手查尔斯顿1号。

scripts.text: Only Dr. Ve know can answer my question. I must find him. He must be in the lab.
scripts.translation: 只有维博士能回答我的问题。我必须找到他。他一定在实验室里。

scripts.text: With complete machine technology to obtain immortality drive, there are many variables.
scripts.translation: 要靠完整的机械技术获得永生驱动，还存在许多变数。

scripts.text: Hmm... On a mediated machine body is still difficult, is it... Do you really need a living donor? Hehe!
scripts.translation: 嗯...让机械身体产生中介效应仍然很困难吗...真的需要活体捐献者吗？嘿嘿！

scripts.text: Charleston 1 is reinitializing itself again. Hm...
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿1号又在重新初始化了。嗯...

scripts.text: I've got so many things to record about this case.
scripts.translation: 这个事件有太多事情要记录了。

scripts.text: With complete machine technology to obtain immortality drive, there are many variables.
scripts.translation: 要靠完整的机械技术获得永生驱动，还存在许多变数。

scripts.text: Hmm... On a mediated machine body is still difficult, is it... Do you really need a living donor? Hehe!
scripts.translation: 嗯...让机械身体产生中介效应仍然很困难吗...真的需要活体捐献者吗？嘿嘿！

scripts.text: No ordinary human can survive the time in the Core. Are you from a different point of time?
scripts.translation: 普通人类无法承受核心区里的时间流逝。你来自另一个时间点吗？

scripts.text: Perhaps you're from the time the makers of Charleston 1 lived...
scripts.translation: 也许你来自查尔斯顿1号的制造者生活的那个时代...

scripts.text: Never mind. You have no business in here. Just go back to whoever broke Charleston 2.
scripts.translation: 算了。你不该待在这里。回到那个破坏查尔斯顿2号的人那里去。

scripts.text: I'd better reset Charleston 2 and wipe the data. It was really close this time.
scripts.translation: 我最好重置查尔斯顿2号并清除数据。这次真是千钧一发。

scripts.text: Charleston 1 created 2 decades ago. I met Charleston 1 to learn her technology.
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿1号是20年前制造的。我是为了学习她的技术才遇见她的。

scripts.text: I'm an observer. I'm here to record the history of Charlestons 1 and 2. I can't repair either of them, but I can wait.
scripts.translation: 我是观察者，负责记录查尔斯顿1号和2号的历史。我无法修理她们，但可以等待。

scripts.text: If Charleston 1 is reinitialized properly, she can reorganize her OS, repair the damage done to her, and reactivate another Charleston 2.
scripts.translation: 如果查尔斯顿1号顺利重新初始化，就能重组操作系统、修复自身损伤，并重新启动另一台查尔斯顿2号。

scripts.text: Charleston 2's OS has improved on its own like a living brain.
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿2号的操作系统像活体大脑一样自行进化了。

scripts.text: Every time Charleston 2 comes back to life, though in a different machine, she's more intelligent, more sensible, and more troublesome.
scripts.translation: 不过，每次查尔斯顿2号复活时，即使换了机体，她都会变得更聪明、更懂事，也更难应付。

scripts.text: There's nothing you or I can do. We'll have to wait until Charleston 1 repairs herself.
scripts.translation: 你我都无能为力，只能等查尔斯顿1号修复自己。

scripts.text: Dr. Ve sighs and writes down something.
scripts.translation: 维博士叹了口气，写下了一些东西。

scripts.text: By the way, there are too many variables to achieve immortality through mechanical engineering.
scripts.translation: 顺带一提，要靠机械工程实现永生，还存在太多变数。

scripts.text: This proves that machines are too dangerous. I need live creatures instead. *Chuckle*
scripts.translation: 这证明机器太危险了。我需要活体生物才行。*窃笑*

scripts.text: Charleston 1 is reinitializing itself again. Hm...
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿1号又在重新初始化了。嗯...

scripts.text: I've got so many things to record about this case.
scripts.translation: 这个事件有太多事情要记录了。

scripts.text: She's in Sleep mode and not moving.
scripts.translation: 她处于休眠模式，一动不动。

scripts.text: Charleston 2 is standing still, her system in Sleep mode. For a moment, her eyes gleamed with unshed tears.
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿 2号静静地站着，系统处于睡眠模式。一瞬间，她的眼中闪烁着未落的泪光。

scripts.text: Charleston 2 is standing still, her system in Sleep mode. For a moment, her eyes gleamed with unshed tears.
scripts.translation: 查尔斯顿 2号静静地站着，系统处于睡眠模式。一瞬间，她的眼中闪烁着未落的泪光。

scripts.text: After break;ing up with Newoz in a nightmare and thinking about wandering around, I was born of demons but lost my goal.
scripts.translation: 和纽奥兹在噩梦里分开后，我想着四处流浪。我生于恶魔，却失去了目标。

scripts.text: I didn't do anything, I just talked to Charleston 2.
scripts.translation: 我什么也没做，只是和查尔斯顿2号聊了几句。

scripts.text: Even if the effort is unremitting...
Did she really say that? That I broke Charleston 2? Sigh...
scripts.translation: 她真这么说吗？是我弄坏了查尔斯顿2号？唉...

scripts.text: I did nothing wrong. I just had a quick conversation with Charleston 2. That's the truth.
scripts.translation: 我没做错什么。我只是和查尔斯顿2号聊了一会儿。这就是事实。

scripts.text: I invited only Newoz. Well, I guess I shouldn't have opened the door for the robot who needed a closure.
scripts.translation: 我只邀请了纽奥兹。唉，我不该为那台需要告别的机器人打开门。

scripts.text: Ferre came with me, but I haven't seen him. No, thanks; I know he'll come back to me.
scripts.translation: 费雷和我一起来的，但我没看到他。没关系，我知道他会回到我身边。

scripts.text: The noise stopped. I can send you back to where you came if you want.
scripts.translation: 噪音停了。如果你愿意，我可以送你回到来时的地方。

scripts.text: The invitee is unable to interfere with the original time, and staying can change nothing.
scripts.translation: 受邀者无法干涉原本的时间，留在这里也改变不了任何事。

scripts.text: Both the noise and the story were entertaining. Come with Newoz, and maybe we can meet again.
scripts.translation: 这阵噪音和这个故事都很有意思。和纽奥兹一起过来，也许我们还能再见面。

scripts.text: Maybe I too should leave for new noises and stories.
scripts.translation: 也许我也该离开，去寻找新的噪音和故事。

scripts.text: You can try, but you can't change anything. How futile that is!
scripts.translation: 你可以试试，但什么都改变不了。真是徒劳！

scripts.text: More Steps must be disposed. Backing up the Step data...
scripts.translation: 必须清除更多变异芯片。正在备份变异芯片数据...

scripts.text: Charleston 2's system was overloaded during regular maintenance. Disconnection from its OS failed.
scripts.translation: 定期维护期间，查尔斯顿2号的系统过载。与其操作系统断开连接失败。

scripts.text: Unauthorized access made to the system was defended, but unauthorized data interception and conflict continued, turning the Nanosteps into monsters.
scripts.translation: 系统抵御了未经授权的访问，但未经授权的数据截取和冲突仍在继续，导致纳米芯片变成了魔物。

scripts.text: To accelerate the main computer's processing rate and reclaim the factory, 50 Steps must be disposed.
scripts.translation: 为了加快主电脑的处理速度并夺回工厂，必须清除50个变异芯片。

scripts.text: To accelerate the main computer's processing rate and reclaim the factory, 50 Steps must be disposed.
scripts.translation: 为了加快主电脑的处理速度并夺回工厂，必须清除50个变异芯片。

scripts.text: Thank you for your hard work. Now backing up the data of the disposed Steps...
scripts.translation: 感谢你的努力。现在开始备份已清除的变异芯片数据...

scripts.text: You turned on the generator. The sounds of turning wheels can be heard.
scripts.translation: 你启动了发电机。可以听到齿轮转动的声音。

scripts.text: The generator must be working. The factory is buzzing with activity.
scripts.translation: 发电机应该在运转了，工厂里又响起了忙碌的嗡嗡声。

scripts.text: You turned on the generator. The sounds of turning wheels can be heard.
scripts.translation: 你启动了发电机。可以听到齿轮转动的声音。

scripts.text: I've followed Newoz. Where is he now?
scripts.translation: 我跟着纽奥兹来了。他现在在哪里？

scripts.text: Enjoying the adventure? There are machines everywhere. It used to be a study. See those books over there?
scripts.translation: 享受这场冒险吗？到处都是机器。这里以前是研究室。看到那边的书了吗？

scripts.text: I was reading a letter from Shalosh, and the next thing I knew, I was in a completely different place. Oh well, I might as well use this chance to write a new song.
scripts.translation: 我正在读沙洛什的信，回过神来就到了一个完全不同的地方。算了，正好趁这个机会写首新歌。

scripts.text: The bookcase is filled with research journals.
scripts.translation: 书架上摆满了研究日志。

scripts.text: Every page is written in mechanical language.
scripts.translation: 每一页都用机械语言书写。

scripts.text: -Dr. Ve seems to be planning a plot, the combination of life and the machine gradually let her crazy, the transformation of the plant into a fortress, her soul and robots...
scripts.translation: - 维博士似乎在策划什么阴谋，生命与机械的结合让他逐渐陷入疯狂。工厂被改造成了堡垒，他的灵魂与机器人...

scripts.text: -In short more and more dangerous, just in case is to study the Charleston 2 escape method.
scripts.translation: - 总之，情况越来越危险。以防万一，得研究一下查尔斯顿 2号的逃脱方法。

scripts.text: Behind is the mechanical language that is incomprehensible.
scripts.translation: 后面是难以理解的机械语言。

scripts.translation: - 每次重置查尔斯顿 2号的操作系统，都会出现另一种人格。这种数据与技术的结合，实在难以解释...

scripts.text: -Did I really succeed in creating humanity? Robotic, I can't say. Did I understand humans?
scripts.translation: - 我真的成功创造了人性吗？对于机器人，我也说不准。我真的理解人类吗？

scripts.translation: - 无所谓了。现在只要看到她，我就很开心，我最好的朋友，我的宝贝，莉莉...
